ttl.name: ABS with EBD & TRC & VSC & BA System

step1.ptxt: Yaw Rate Sensor & G Sensor 0-point Acquisition (TaSCAN)

item.ptxt: If the actuator assembly (with built-in skid control computer) or yaw rate sensor (with built-in G sensor) has been replaced, perform 0 point calibration.

Once the 0 point has been stored 1 time, it will not be re-acquired until the data is cleared; therefore, if the yaw rate sensor has been replaced, perform 0 point calibration after clearing the 0 point.

Always perform 0 point calibration on a level surface (gradient within 1%), and do not rock the vehicle or open and close the doors, etc. during the procedure. Also, to avoid idling vibration, do not start the engine.

step2.ptxt: Clearing Yaw Rate & G Sensor 0 Point Memory

step3.ptxt: Turn the ignition switch off and connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Move the shift lever to P.

Turn the ignition switch ON, and following the display on the SST (TaSCAN) screen, select and execute "Utility" → "ABS/VSC/ECB" → "Backup Memory Clear". At this time, check that "VSC Check" is displayed on the multi-information display in the meter.
Turn IG OFF.

atten3.ptxt: After clearing the 0 point, if the ignition switch is turned ON with the shift lever in the P position for 15 seconds or more, only the 0 point of the yaw rate sensor is stored and the VSC warning goes off. If the vehicle is driven in this condition, G sensor 0 point uncalibrated is stored and a VSC system malfunction is displayed.

step2.ptxt: Acquiring Yaw Rate & G Sensor 0 Point

step3.ptxt: Turn the ignition switch off and connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
With the shift lever in the P position, turn the ignition switch ON and check that the initial check of the indicators finishes.
On the SST (TaSCAN) screen, select "Diagnosis" → "System Diagnosis/Chassis" → "System Name/ABS/VSC" → "Mode Change (Check)" in that order to switch to test mode.

Keep the vehicle stationary for approximately 2 seconds after switching to test mode, and check that the "VSC Check" display on the multi-information display in the meter disappears and "VSC TEST MODE" is displayed.

item.ptxt: If test mode is entered with the shift lever in any position other than P, the yaw rate sensor and G sensor 0 point uncalibrated malfunction code is stored.
If the 0 point uncalibrated malfunction code is stored, perform the procedure again from 0 point memory clearing.

atten4.ptxt: After 0 point calibration is completed, the display in the meter changes to the test mode display.

step3.ptxt: On the SST (TaSCAN) screen, select "Diagnosis" → "System Diagnosis/Chassis" → "System Name/ABS/VSC" → "Mode Change (Normal)" in that order to switch to normal mode.

step1.ptxt: Yaw Rate Sensor & G Sensor 0-point Acquisition (Shorting DLC3)

item.ptxt: If the actuator assembly (with built-in skid control computer) or yaw rate sensor has been replaced, perform 0 point calibration.
Once the 0 point has been stored, it will not be re-acquired until the data is cleared; therefore, if the yaw rate sensor has been replaced, perform 0 point calibration after clearing the 0 point.

Always perform 0 point calibration on a level surface (gradient within 1%), and do not rock the vehicle or open and close the doors, etc. during the procedure. Also, to avoid idling vibration, do not start the engine.

step2.ptxt: Clearing Yaw Rate & G Sensor 0 Point

step3.ptxt: Turn the ignition switch off and move the shift lever to the P position.
Turn the ignition switch ON, wait approximately 3 seconds, and check that the initial check of the indicator lights finishes.
Using SST, short ←→ open terminals 12 (TS) ←→ 4 (CG) of DLC3 4 times or more within 8 seconds, and check that "VSC Check" is displayed on the multi-information display in the meter.

item.ptxt: Never connect the connector in the wrong position, as this will cause a malfunction.

After clearing the 0 point, if the ignition switch is turned ON for 15 seconds or more with the shift lever in the P position, only the 0 point of the yaw rate sensor is stored and the "VSC Check" display on the multi-information display in the meter disappears. If the vehicle is driven in this condition, G sensor 0 point uncalibrated is stored and a VSC malfunction is displayed.

step2.ptxt: Acquiring Yaw Rate & G Sensor 0 Point

step3.ptxt: Turn the ignition switch off and move the shift lever to the P position.
Using SST, connect terminals 12 (TS) ←→ 4 (CG) of DLC3.

atten3.ptxt: Never connect the connector in the wrong position, as this will cause a malfunction.

step3.ptxt: Turn IG ON.
Keep the vehicle stationary for approximately 2 seconds, and check that the "VSC Check" display on the multi-information display in the meter disappears and "VSC TEST MODE" is displayed.

item.ptxt: If test mode is entered with the shift lever in any position other than P, the yaw rate sensor and G sensor 0 point uncalibrated malfunction code is stored.
If the 0 point uncalibrated malfunction code is stored, perform the procedure again from 0 point memory clearing.
After 0 point calibration is completed, the display in the meter changes to the test mode display.

Since the 0 point is acquired at the same time as the initial check of the warning lights immediately after the ignition switch is turned ON, if the multi-information display in the meter shows the test mode display, it can be judged that 0 point calibration has been completed.

step3.ptxt: Turn the ignition switch off and disconnect terminals 12 (TS) ←→ 4 (CG) of DLC3.

step1.ptxt: Entering and Exiting Maintenance Mode (Using TaSCAN)

atten4.ptxt: By entering "Maintenance Mode", VSC and TRC operation is prohibited.

atten2.ptxt: When using a drum tester in "Maintenance Mode", secure the vehicle with lock chains for safe operation.

item.ptxt: Since "Maintenance Mode" is ended by turning the ignition switch off, if the ignition switch is turned off during the inspection and the inspection is then continued, perform the "Maintenance Mode" entry operation again.
Never drive the vehicle in "maintenance mode".

step3.ptxt: With the ignition switch OFF, connect SST (TaSCAN) to DLC3.
Turn the ignition switch ON, and select "Utility" → "ABS/VSC/ECB" → "Maintenance Mode" in that order on the SST (TaSCAN) screen.

Following the display on the SST (TaSCAN) screen, enter "Maintenance Mode". At this time, check that the slip indicator light in the combination meter comes on. (Confirmation that "Maintenance Mode" is established)
Turn the ignition switch off to cancel "Maintenance Mode". At this time, check that the slip indicator light in the combination meter is off. (Confirmation that "Maintenance Mode" is canceled)

step1.ptxt: Entering and Exiting Maintenance Mode (without TaSCAN)

atten4.ptxt: By entering "Maintenance Mode", VSC and TRC operation is prohibited.

atten2.ptxt: When using a drum tester in "Maintenance Mode", secure the vehicle with lock chains for safe operation.

item.ptxt: Since "Maintenance Mode" is ended by turning the ignition switch off, if the ignition switch is turned off during the inspection and the inspection is then continued, perform the "Maintenance Mode" entry operation again.
Never drive the vehicle in "maintenance mode".

Complete the parking brake and brake pedal inputs within 30 seconds after starting the engine, and complete the operations from the first parking brake operation to the last brake pedal operation within 15 seconds.

step3.ptxt: Stop the engine.
Release the parking brake.
Start the engine while depressing the brake pedal, and keep the pedal depressed.
Depress the parking brake pedal to apply the parking brake.
With the parking brake applied, repeat "release → depress" of the brake pedal 2 times, and keep the brake pedal depressed.
With the brake pedal depressed, operate the parking brake pedal to repeat "release → apply (on)" 2 times, and leave the parking brake applied.
With the parking brake applied again, repeat "release → depress" of the brake pedal 2 times.
Check that the slip indicator light in the combination meter comes on. (Confirmation that "Maintenance Mode" is established)
Turn the ignition switch off to cancel "Maintenance Mode". At this time, check that the slip indicator light in the combination meter is off. (Confirmation that "Maintenance Mode" is canceled)
